title: Flyhub HRMS
shortDesc: Enterprise-grade Human Resource Management System built for Flyhub's 100+ member organization.
fullDesc:
A full-featured web-based HRMS built entirely from scratch — both frontend and backend — to manage Flyhub's internal HR operations. The system handles employee onboarding, leave management, attendance tracking, performance workflows, and organizational hierarchy visualization.

Frontend is built with React + TypeScript + Redux for predictable state management. The REST API backend is powered by Express + MongoDB + Mongoose. The platform continues to grow with new modules and integrations.
highlights: Sole architect and developer of both frontend and backend
Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions

title: Faces of Flyhub
shortDesc: Employee profile platform combining internal recognition with public-facing team showcasing for Flyhub.
fullDesc: A public-facing employee directory and profile platform where Flyhub team members can build personal professional profiles. Built with React on the frontend and Express + MongoDB on the backend, featuring public profile URLs and shareable profile links used in recruitment and client communication.
highlights: Public shareable profile URLs for each employee
Custom profile editor with real-time preview

title: Flyhub Apps Showcase
shortDesc: Product showcase website for Flyhub's app ecosystem with a custom Express-based CMS backend.
fullDesc: A polished marketing website built to showcase all of Flyhub's products and mobile applications. Includes a custom content management system backend built with Express, enabling non-technical staff to update product listings and content without engineering involvement.
highlights: Custom headless CMS built with Express
Dynamic product pages with SEO metadata

title: Flyhub Agents UAE
shortDesc: Cross-platform B2B travel agent mobile application for the UAE market, built with Flutter.
fullDesc: A cross-platform mobile application targeting travel agents in the UAE market. Built with Flutter and Dart for native performance on both iOS and Android. Integrates with Flyhub's core travel API to deliver flight search, booking management, and agent-specific tooling for a premium travel B2B experience.
highlights: Deployed to UAE market on both iOS and Android
Real-time flight search and booking workflows
Deep integration with Flyhub B2B API
